name: Ripio wCOP
oneLiner: WCOP is Ripio's Colombian-peso wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Colombian-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments backing Ripio wCOP at a one Colombian peso target
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed local-currency stablecoin route targeting 1 WCOP = 1 COP through Ripio's wFIAT issuance, redemption, and on/off-ramp infrastructure

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wCOP is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

reserves.name: Colombian-peso cash and local-currency liquid instruments

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: COP is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WCOP is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WCOP during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
